requirement: Create a clinical metric: reject a code already used by an applied, live metric, map the command into a rule-less applied metric, persist it, and return the new ID with Created status.

preconditions.text: No applied live metric holds the requested code
An applied live metric already holds the requested code

inputs.text: Create PSI while an in-use CURB-65 exists
Create PSI while an existing PSI metric is switched off
Create CURB-65 while a soft-deleted CURB-65 exists
Create CURB-65 while an applied CURB-65 exists
Create PSI while an applied PSI exists
Create IDSA/ATS while an applied IDSA/ATS exists
Create CURB-65 with a mapper that reports a mapping failure

returns.text: Success with Created status and the new metric ID
The metric is persisted with every field, applied, and without rules
A code is only reserved while its metric is applied and live
Failure with BadRequest and the 'already exists and in used' error
Failure with BadRequest from the mapper; nothing reaches the database

exception_text: No unhandled exception; every rejection is returned as a failed Result
